cases.sentence: ___ вырос и был отнят от груди.
cases.translation: The child grew and was weaned.
cases.explain: Ребёнок is the subject of вырос/был отнят, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Сын этой ___ не разделит наследство с моим сыном Исааком.
cases.translation: The son of this servant will not share the inheritance with my son Isaac.
cases.explain: The genitive рабыни shows possession — 'the son of this servant'.

cases.sentence: Авимелех и Фихол, начальник его войска, сказали ___, «Бог с тобой во всем, что ты делаешь».
cases.translation: Abimelech and Phicol, the commander of his army, said to Abraham, 'God is with you in all that you do.'
cases.explain: The verb сказать takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.sentence: И мать взяла для него ___ из Египта.
cases.translation: And his mother took a wife for him from Egypt.
cases.explain: The verb взять takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Заключив союз с ___, Авимелех и Фихол вернулись в землю филистимлян.
cases.translation: Having made a covenant at Beersheba, Abimelech and Phicol returned to the land of the Philistines.
cases.explain: The preposition с governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Авраам жил на ___ филистимлян долгое время.
cases.translation: Abraham lived in the land of the Philistines for a long time.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Авраам призвал там имя ___, Бога Вечного.
cases.translation: Abraham called there on the name of the Lord, the Everlasting God.
cases.explain: The genitive Господа shows possession — 'the name of the Lord'.

reading.ru: Сара забеременела и родила Аврааму сына, когда тот уже состарился, в то самое время, как обещал ему Бог.
reading.question: When did Sarah bear a son to Abraham?
options: At the very time God had promised, in his old age
Ten years after settling in Canaan
reading.correct: At the very time God had promised, in his old age
reading.explain: The text says Sarah bore a son 'в то самое время, как обещал ему Бог' — at the very time God had promised.

reading.ru: Бог заставил меня смеяться, каждый, кто услышит об этом, рассмеется вместе со мной.
reading.question: What did Sarah say God had done for her?
options: Made her laugh, so that all who hear will laugh with her
reading.correct: Made her laugh, so that all who hear will laugh with her
reading.explain: Sarah says God made her laugh and that everyone who hears will laugh with her.

reading.ru: Сара увидела, что сын, которого египтянка Агарь родила Аврааму, насмехается над Исааком
reading.question: What did Sarah see Hagar's son doing?
reading.explain: The text says Sarah saw the son of Hagar 'насмехается над Исааком' — mocking Isaac.

reading.ru: Бог сказал ему, не огорчайся из-за мальчика и рабыни, послушайся Сары и сделай все, как она говорит, потому что через Исаака ты будешь иметь потомство, которое я тебе обещал.
reading.question: What did God tell Abraham to do about Sarah's demand?
options: Listen to Sarah and do as she says
Refuse and keep Ishmael at home
reading.correct: Listen to Sarah and do as she says
reading.explain: God told Abraham not to be grieved, but to listen to Sarah's voice and do as she said.

reading.ru: Бог услышал плач мальчика, и ангел Бога обратился к Агаре с небес и сказал ей
reading.question: How did God respond to the boy's crying in the wilderness?
options: His angel called to Hagar from heaven
He sent rain to the desert
He sent Abraham to find them
reading.correct: His angel called to Hagar from heaven
reading.explain: The text says the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven after God heard the boy crying.

reading.ru: Тут Бог открыл ей глаза, и она увидела колодец с водой.
reading.question: What did Hagar see after God opened her eyes?
reading.explain: The text says God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water.

reading.ru: В то время Авимелех и Фихол, начальник его войска, сказали Аврааму, «Бог с тобой во всем, что ты делаешь.
reading.question: What did Abimelech and Phicol ask of Abraham?
options: To swear he would not deal falsely with him or his descendants
To leave the land at once
To let his son marry Abimelech's daughter
reading.correct: To swear he would not deal falsely with him or his descendants
reading.explain: Abimelech asked Abraham to swear by God not to deal falsely with him, his children, or his descendants.

reading.ru: Авраам посадил в Версавии Тамариск и призвал там имя Господа, Бога Вечного.
reading.question: What did Abraham do at Beersheba after the covenant?
options: Planted a tamarisk tree and called on the name of the Lord
Built an altar and offered a sacrifice
reading.correct: Planted a tamarisk tree and called on the name of the Lord
reading.explain: The text says Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and called on the name of the Lord, the Everlasting God.
